errors.text_span: Veränderung der Importanteile der auf der horizontalen Achse abgebildeten Länder – China, Vietnam, Indien, Mexiko, Polen und Deutschland – an den Importen der in der Legende genannten Länder (China, USA, Japan, Indien, Frankreich, Vereinigtes Königreich, Mexiko, Thailand, Malaysia, Brasilien)
errors.evidence: The description misinterprets the relationship between the x-axis and the legend. It states the chart shows the change in import shares of the x-axis countries within the imports of the legend countries. The correct interpretation is the reverse: the chart shows the change in the import share that a legend country (as an exporter) has in the total imports of an x-axis country (as an importer).

The word "extrem" (extreme) is subjective, evaluative language, which the prompt instructs to avoid. A more neutral description would state the values or their position relative to others (e.g., 'the lowest values').
